# Enable profile metrics

The dashboard uses [lowlighter/metrics](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics) to display general statistics, repository languages, and an isometric contribution calendar. The generated image is stored in this repository as `github-metrics.svg`.

## One-time setup

1. Open [the classic token creation page](https://github.com/settings/tokens/new) while signed in to the **C-J8** account.
2. Use a name such as **GitHub Profile Metrics**, choose an expiration date, and leave **all scopes unchecked**. The selected plugins only require public account data.
3. Copy the token directly into [a new repository secret](https://github.com/C-J8/C-J8/settings/secrets/actions/new) named exactly **METRICS_TOKEN**. Never place its value in a file, commit, message, or README.
4. Once the configuration is on the `main` branch, open [Actions](https://github.com/C-J8/C-J8/actions), select **GitHub Metrics**, and click **Run workflow**.
5. Wait for the run to finish. The workflow will commit `github-metrics.svg` automatically.

The dashboard is scheduled to update every day at **06:23 America/Sao_Paulo time**. GitHub may delay scheduled runs. Manual runs remain available.

## Validate before publishing

If these files are on a preparation branch, the workflow can be run on that branch after the workflow itself is available on the default branch. The image is committed to the branch selected for the run.

Before publishing the README, confirm that `github-metrics.svg` exists and that the dashboard renders correctly.

## Permissions and maintenance

- `METRICS_TOKEN` reads public account data.
- `github.token` is generated by GitHub Actions and writes the image only to this repository.
- The action is pinned to commit `65836723097537a54cd8eb90f61839426b4266b6`, which matched the stable release checked on 2026-09-01.
- Replace `METRICS_TOKEN` in the same secret when it expires.
- The language chart reflects repository composition; it does not represent time spent coding.
- GitHub may disable scheduled workflows in public repositories after 60 days without repository activity. Re-enable the workflow from the Actions tab if this happens.

Documentation: [action setup](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/blob/master/.github/readme/partials/documentation/setup/action.md), [languages](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/blob/master/source/plugins/languages/README.md), and [isometric calendar](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/blob/master/source/plugins/isocalendar/README.md).
